papers.title: Defect, Microstructure, and Mechanical Property of Ti-6Al-4V Alloy Fabricated by High-Power Selective Laser Melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Monash University, Clayton, VIC, 3800, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Sheng Cao
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Monash University, Clayton, VIC, 3800, Australia

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文研究了高功率SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V的缺陷和力学性能，对增材制造生物医用钛合金有参考价值，但未涉及多孔结构或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not investigate porous structures, fatigue testing, or stress shielding, and lacks biomedical implant context such as osseointegration or surface roughness.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究高功率SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V的缺陷和组织对力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用高功率SLM制备样品，通过金相、XRD和拉伸测试分析
summary_zh.result: 发现高功率下缺陷增多，但适当参数可获得良好力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和微观观察验证

summary_en.motivation: To understand the effect of defects and microstructure on the mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by high-power selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated using high-power SLM and characterized by optical microscopy, XRD, and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: Increased defects at high power were observed, but optimal parameters yielded good mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Validation through tensile testing and microstructural observation.
